summary_1line: Allied kings visit the exiled Pandavas; Krishna vows vengeance, Arjuna praises Krishna’s divine nature, and Draupadi recounts her humiliation and past wrongs by Duryodhana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna, surrounded by angry allied kings in the forest, vows that the earth will drink the blood of Duryodhana and his allies.
Arjuna stands before Krishna in the forest assembly, praising him as the cosmic Vishnu while the gathered warriors listen in awe.
Draupadi, disheveled and furious, approaches Krishna among the assembled kings and recounts how she was dragged into the Kuru court with a single cloth.
